The code should allow the user to specify the number of spatial and temporal divisions, the adaptive refinement stop threshold, and the adaptive refinement and coarsening parameters. import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from fealpy.mesh import TriangleMesh
from fealpy.timeintegratoralg import UniformTimeLine
from fealpy.functionspace import LagrangeFiniteElementSpace2d
from fealpy.model.heat_conduction_model_2d import HeatConductionModel2d
from fealpy.tools.show import showmultirate

def main(
    nx=10, ny=10,           # spatial divisions
    nt=20,                  # temporal divisions
    theta=0.2,              # adaptive refinement stop threshold
    refine_fraction=0.3,    # fraction of elements to refine
    coarsen_fraction=0.1,   # fraction of elements to coarsen
    T=0.1,                  # final time
    plot_steps=[0, 5, 10, 15, 20] # time steps to plot solution
):
    # Domain and mesh
    domain = [0, 1, 0, 1]
    mesh = TriangleMesh.from_box(domain, nx=nx, ny=ny)
    model = HeatConductionModel2d()
    timeline = UniformTimeLine(0, T, nt)
    dt = timeline.current_time_step_length()
    space = LagrangeFiniteElementSpace2d(mesh, p=1)
    u = space.function()  # initial solution

    # Initial condition
    node = mesh.node
    u[:] = model.u0(node[:, 0], node[:, 1])

    # Dirichlet boundary condition
    def dirichlet_bc(p):
        return model.dirichlet(p[:, 0], p[:, 1], 0)

    # Time stepping
    for k in range(0, timeline.number_of_time_steps()):
        t1 = timeline.next_time_level()
        t0 = timeline.current_time_level()
        dt = t1 - t0

        # Assemble system
        A = space.stiff_matrix()
        M = space.mass_matrix()
        F = space.source_vector(lambda x, y: model.f(x, y, t1))

        # Implicit Euler: (M + dt*A) u1 = M u0 + dt*F
        lhs = M + dt * A
        rhs = M @ u + dt * F

        # Apply Dirichlet BC
        bc = space.dirichlet_bc(dirichlet_bc)
        u1 = space.function()
        space.set_dirichlet_bc(lhs, rhs, bc, dirichlet_bc)

        # Solve
        u1[:] = np.linalg.solve(lhs, rhs)

        # Error estimation and adaptive refinement
        eta = space.recovery_estimate(u1)
        max_eta = np.max(eta)
        print(f"Time step {k+1}, t={t1:.4f}, error estimator: {max_eta:.4e}")

        # Save mesh plot before refinement
        plt.figure()
        mesh.add_plot(plt)
        plt.title(f"Mesh before refinement, step {k+1}")
        plt.savefig(f"mesh_before_refine_step_{k+1}.png")
        plt.close()

        # Adaptive refinement
        while max_eta > theta:
            marked = eta > refine_fraction * max_eta
            if not np.any(marked):
                break
            mesh, idx = mesh.adaptive_refine(marked)
            space = LagrangeFiniteElementSpace2d(mesh, p=1)
            u1 = space.interpolate(u1)
            eta = space.recovery_estimate(u1)
            max_eta = np.max(eta)
            # Save mesh plot after each refinement
            plt.figure()
            mesh.add_plot(plt)
            plt.title(f"Mesh after refinement, step {k+1}")
            plt.savefig(f"mesh_after_refine_step_{k+1}.png")
            plt.close()

        # Adaptive coarsening
        eta = space.recovery_estimate(u1)
        min_eta = np.min(eta)
        marked_coarse = eta < coarsen_fraction * max_eta
        if np.any(marked_coarse):
            mesh, idx = mesh.adaptive_coarsen(marked_coarse)
            space = LagrangeFiniteElementSpace2d(mesh, p=1)
            u1 = space.interpolate(u1)
            # Save mesh plot after coarsening
            plt.figure()
            mesh.add_plot(plt)
            plt.title(f"Mesh after coarsening, step {k+1}")
            plt.savefig(f"mesh_after_coarsen_step_{k+1}.png")
            plt.close()

        # Plot solution at specified steps
        if (k+1) in plot_steps:
            fig = plt.figure()
            ax = fig.add_subplot(111)
            mesh.add_plot(ax)
            space.plot(u1, ax=ax, shading='gouraud')
            plt.title(f"Numerical solution at t={t1:.4f}")
            plt.savefig(f"solution_step_{k+1}.png")
            plt.close()

        # Prepare for next step
        u = u1.copy()
        timeline.advance()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main(
        nx=10,
        ny=10,
        nt=20,
        theta=0.01,
        refine_fraction=0.3,
        coarsen_fraction=0.1,
        T=0.1,
        plot_steps=[0, 5, 10, 15, 20]
    )
```
